notes.title: Jumps VR Demo available again
notes.notes: You can download the Jumps VR demo from the store page again. The game still has no planned release date, but the demo will stay available.

notes.title: Jumps VR development put on hold indefinitely
notes.notes: Unfortunately development has been put on hold, and right now there's no prediction of Jumps VR ever being release. You can of course still play the original non-VR version of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/544310/Jumps/]Jumps[/url].
